name: B10-0266/2026 (ECR) – Repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Iran. It condemns the Iranian authorities for crushing protests that began in December 2025 and for executing detained protesters and political prisoners, especially during the regional conflict that started in February 2026. It demands that Iran stop the executions, release everyone held over the protests, and drop convictions based on confessions forced by torture. It also asks the Council to sanction Iranian judges and invites Reza Pahlavi to speak to the Parliament.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states demands and opinions.
- The demands target Iran's authorities and affect protesters, political prisoners and religious minorities.
- Next, the Council is asked to sanction Iranian judges; the text goes to Iran's leaders.
